subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Entangle
solution:
The correct answer is: **Trap**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Entangle"** means to cause something to become twisted together or caught in something. It can also refer to getting involved in a complicated or difficult situation. (उलझाना)

 
 
• **Example: **His fishing line got entangled in the weeds.
 
 
 
• **"Trap"** refers to a device or situation designed to catch or hold something. It can also mean to catch or ensnare someone or something. (फँसाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The hunters set up a trap to catch the wild boar.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Entangle' **is **'Trap'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Trap**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Intrude** (अतिक्रमण करना): To enter a place or situation where one is unwelcome or uninvited.

 
 
• **Example:** Please don’t intrude on our private conversation.
 
 
 
• **Engross** (मग्न करना): To fully absorb the attention or interest of someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She was so engrossed in her book that she didn’t hear the doorbell ring.
 
 
 
• **Enlarge** (बड़ा करना): To make something bigger in size or scope.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to enlarge their house by adding another floor.
